component.name: mdgitjournal
component.summary: Minimal markdown journal synced with git

description.p: A small, fast markdown journal. Every entry is a plain .md file in an ordinary git repository, so you have version history from the first keystroke, offline and without an account.

ul.li: Two views of the same text: monospace source, or a quiet serif view that keeps the markdown visible
Never changes a byte you didn't touch
Optional sync with one GitHub repository, with explicit Pull and Commit and Push
When edits collide, both versions are kept; text is never lost
Images are stored as small JPEGs with all metadata removed
No telemetry, no analytics, no server
